executive_summary: One parameter-free original-kernel observation-age alignment experiment, locked after exposed baseline diagnostics and before any candidate forecast/score. No economic directional alpha claim.
selected_hypothesis: Advance unchanged V5.1 joint kernel from the final observed anchor through the known as-of gap plus each requested business-day horizon.
formula: If every last date equals asof, return original forecast bytes exactly. Otherwise require common last observation date across the three UST assets; gap=np.busday_count(last_date,asof), steps=[gap+h for h in [1,2,3,4]]. Invoke unchanged original CLI with only research card targets.horizons remapped to steps, then rename output horizon keys back to requested h. Same target dates, input values, seed, draw count, family and mode. No new weights/scale/drift coefficients.
training_period: NONE; parameter-free. Baseline diagnostics were already observed, and no untouched holdout is claimed.
family: T2-F3, empty-text controlled route only for active experiment; all78 authored age0 cards return exact baseline.
date_calendar: Monday-Friday business days only, consistent with this frozen research projection. No invented holiday calendar or forecast release contract.
evaluation_grid: Primary only complete12-cell UST grids; all incomplete origins/cells retained and reported separately. No target imputation. Same complete-origin set for baseline/candidate/primary/placebo.

metric.implementation: Authenticated commonv2.6.1 CRPS/variogram and official Track24582e95 tail/_composite; imported functions only.
metric.primary_research_proxy: 0.5*mean(CRPS_candidate)/mean(CRPS_baseline)+0.3*mean(VG_candidate)/mean(VG_baseline)+0.2*mean(tail_candidate)/mean(tail_baseline), over same complete origins. Baseline=1.0. Recalculate paired denominators for each uncertainty/falsification subset.
metric.single_cell: Use weights5/7 marginal and2/7 tail on matched cells as separate proxy; not a real official single-cell card score.

success_criteria.correct_age_beats_permuted_age: Required for mechanism-specific alpha. If fewer than20 complete origins actually have different permuted gaps, mark UNKNOWN and never declare supported alpha.

falsification: Remove the origin giving the greatest positive primary proxy contribution; no reselection
Remove the calendar quarter with greatest summed primary gain; no reselection
Additional input lag: drop last observation date for all assets, same targets, same code, baseline and candidate both recomputed; no refit
Permute observed gaps across the154origins with seed18019 before scoring, same kernel; detect degenerate nearly constant-age placebo
Record all78age0 authored cards as exact fallback; execute four representative family identity controls already passed

Check tail/joint damage; all failures and unavailable controls retained
scope_restrictions: No adapter for unknown release targets or heterogeneous anchors
